comparison.objective: Switch on a variac at zero and ramp it to 60 V; candidate breaks and recovers HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered rocker operation, slow knob rotation, dial reading, and regrasp versus small-hole coaxial alignment, bimanual impact regulation, and fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Power-on at 0 V, ramp no faster than 10 V/s, final 60 V, never above 65 V versus four clean fractures with all tangs contained and hardware undamaged.
comparison.reason: The record tests continuous rotary regulation under electrical limits, not contact-loaded fracture or debris recovery. No separate spec versions were provided.
